title: A Study of MK-6913 for the Treatment of Hot Flashes in Postmenopausal Women (6913-004)
brief_summary: This study will assess the safety, tolerability, and efficacy of MK-6913 for the treatment of moderate-to-very-severe vasomotor symptoms (hot flashes or hot flushes) in postmenopausal women. The primary study hypothesis is that one or more doses of MK-6913 will result in a significantly greater reduction from baseline, compared to placebo, in the number of moderate to very severe hot flashes after 4 weeks of treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Woman with at least 50 moderate to very severe hot flash episodes per week
* Postmenopausal
* Between 45 and 60 years of age if naturally menopausal, or between 35 and 60 if she underwent a bilateral oophorectomy
* Not receiving hormone therapy
* Has had both a normal mammogram and a normal Pap test in the past 6 months
* Generally healthy

Exclusion Criteria:

* A history of cancer, except for certain skin cancers
* Undiagnosed vaginal bleeding or any uterine endometrial disorder
* Currently uses tobacco products, or has used them in the last 6 months
* Has human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)
condition: Moderate to Severe Vasomotor Symptoms in Postmenopausal
